LostVikingsMasteryOlafTheStout.name: Olaf the Stout
LostVikingsMasteryOlafTheStout.description: Passive: Olaf gains 20% bonus maximum Health. Every 5 seconds, Olaf gains 75 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 75%. Stores up to 2 charges.

LostVikingsMasterySpyGames.name: Spy Games
LostVikingsMasterySpyGames.description: After standing still for 3 seconds, Erik gains Stealth and his Sight Radius is increased by 75%. The Stealth persists for 3 seconds after moving and once removed, Erik gains 75% bonus Basic Attack damage for 6 seconds.

LostVikingsMasteryExplosiveAttacks.name: Explosive Attacks
LostVikingsMasteryExplosiveAttacks.description: Baleog's Basic Attack splash damage against non-Heroes is no longer reduced by 50%.

LostVikingsMasteryVikingBribery.name: Viking Bribery
LostVikingsMasteryVikingBribery.description: Enemy Minions or captured Mercenaries killed near The Lost Vikings grant stacks of Bribe. Use 40 stacks to bribe target Mercenary, instantly defeating them. Does not work on Elite Mercenaries. Maximum stacks available: 200.

LostVikingsMasteryPainDontHurt.name: Pain Don't Hurt
LostVikingsMasteryPainDontHurt.description: Baleog's Basic Attacks and splash damage heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Healing is doubled against Heroes.

LostVikingsMasteryErikTheSwift.name: Erik the Swift
LostVikingsMasteryErikTheSwift.description: Permanently increases Erik's base Movement Speed by 10%, and as long as Erik is moving he heals 34 Health per second.

LostVikingsMasteryItsASabotage.name: It's a Sabotage!
LostVikingsMasteryItsASabotage.description: Erik's Basic Attacks against Structures light them on fire for 3 seconds, causing 225 damage.

GenericTalentMercenaryLord.name: Mercenary Lord
GenericTalentMercenaryLord.description: Friendly non-Boss Mercenaries near your Hero deal 50% more damage. Gain 50 Armor against Minions and Mercenaries, reducing the damage taken by 50%.

LostVikingsMasteryBaleogTheFierce.name: Baleog the Fierce
LostVikingsMasteryBaleogTheFierce.description: Increase Baleog's attack range by 2.5. While near Olaf and Erik, he becomes inspired by the power of teamwork and his Attack Speed is increased by 50%.

LostVikingsMasterySpinToWin.name: Spin To Win!
LostVikingsMasterySpinToWin.description: Activate to have each Viking deal 85 damage to nearby enemies. Deals 100% bonus damage to enemy Heroes.

LostVikingsMasteryNorseForce.name: Norse Force!
LostVikingsMasteryNorseForce.description: All Vikings gain a 140 to 308 point Shield, increasing in strength for each Viking alive. Lasts 4 seconds.

LostVikingsHeroicAbilityLongboatRaid.name: Longboat Raid!
LostVikingsHeroicAbilityLongboatRaid.description: Hop into an Unstoppable Longboat that fires at nearby enemies for 128 damage per second and can fire a mortar that deals 228 damage in an area. The boat has increased Health for each Viking inside. If the boat is destroyed by enemies, all Vikings are Stunned for 1 second. Lasts 1

LostVikingsHeroicAbilityPlayAgain.name: Play Again!
LostVikingsHeroicAbilityPlayAgain.description: Summon, fully heal, and revive all Lost Vikings at target location after a Viking channels for 2 seconds. Only one Viking may attempt to summon at a time.

LostVikingsMasteryHunkaBurningOlaf.name: Hunka' Burning Olaf
LostVikingsMasteryHunkaBurningOlaf.description: Olaf deals 34 damage every second to nearby enemies.

LostVikingsMasteryJump.name: Jump!
LostVikingsMasteryJump.description: Makes all Vikings Invulnerable and able to pass over enemies for 1.5 seconds.

LostVikingsMasteryNordicAttackSquad.name: Nordic Attack Squad
LostVikingsMasteryNordicAttackSquad.description: While Olaf, Baleog, and Erik are near each of the other two Vikings, their Basic Attacks deal bonus damage equal to 1.25% maximum Health to enemy Heroes.

LostVikingsMasteryLargeAndInCharge.name: Large and In Charge
LostVikingsMasteryLargeAndInCharge.description: When Olaf charges enemies, they are stunned for 1 second.

LostVikingsMasteryImpatienceIsAVirtue.name: Impatience Is a Virtue
LostVikingsMasteryImpatienceIsAVirtue.description: Enemies damaged by a Viking's Basic Attack reduce the cooldown of all Viking Abilities by 0.3125 seconds.

LostVikingsGoGoGo64KBMarathon.name: 64 KB Marathon
LostVikingsGoGoGo64KBMarathon.description: Activating Go Go Go! grants an additional 40% Movement Speed and breaks the Vikings out of Roots and Slows.

HeroGenericExecutionerPassive.name: Executioner
HeroGenericExecutionerPassive.description: Attacking a Hero that is Slowed, Rooted, or Stunned increases your Basic Attack damage by 30% for 3 seconds.

LostVikingsMasteryWereOnABoat.name: Ragnarok 'n' Roll!
LostVikingsMasteryWereOnABoat.description: The Longboat can attack two targets at once and the range of its Mortar is increased by 100%. Reduce Longboat Raid!'s cooldown by 30 seconds.

LostVikingsMasteryCheckpointReached.name: Checkpoint Reached
LostVikingsMasteryCheckpointReached.description: 10 seconds after using Play Again!, any dead Vikings are revived and summoned again, and all are healed to full.

LostVikingsMasteryTheSequel.name: The Sequel!
LostVikingsMasteryTheSequel.description: Reduces the Lost Vikings's death timer by 50%.

LostVikingsTalentFuryoftheStorm.name: Fury of the Storm
LostVikingsTalentFuryoftheStorm.description: Every 5 seconds, the next Basic Attack will deal an additional 41 damage to the target, and 105 damage to all nearby Minions, Mercenaries and Monsters. Each Viking has their own cooldown.
